title: 统计不同回文子序列
summary: 统计字符串中不同的非空回文子序列数量，结果对 10^9+7 取模。
insight: 区间两端不同用容斥合并子区间；两端相同时，内部同字符出现零次、一次或多次决定新增两个、一个或需减去被重复计算的内部区间。
pitfalls: 统计不同字符串而非下标选择数
减法取模后要恢复非负
两端相同分支需寻找内部首个与末个同字符位置

solutions.title: 按内部同端字符数量分类的区间 DP
solutions.idea: 从短区间到长区间计算不同回文子序列数。
steps: 若相同，找 low/high：无同字符为 2*inner+2，恰一为 +1，多于一为 2*inner-dp[low+1][high-1]；统一取模

code.java: class Solution { public int countPalindromicSubsequences(String s){int n=s.length();long mod=1000000007L;long[][] dp=new long[n][n];for(int i=n-1;i>=0;i--){dp[i][i]=1;for(int j=i+1;j<n;j++){if(s.charAt(i)!=s.charAt(j))dp[i][j]=dp[i+1][j]+dp[i][j-1]-dp[i+1][j-1];else{int low=i+1,high=j-1;while(low<=high&&s.charAt(low)!=s.charAt(i))low++;while(low<=high&&s.charAt(high)!=s.charAt(i))high--;long inner=dp[i+1][j-1];if(low>high)dp[i][j]=2*inner+2;else if(low==high)dp[i][j]=2*inner+1;else dp[i][j]=2*inner-dp[low+1][high-1];}dp[i][j]=(dp[i][j]%mod+mod)%mod;}}return(int)dp[0][n-1];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countPalindromicSubsequences(s:String):Int{val n=s.length;val mod=1000000007L;val dp=Array(n){LongArray(n)};for(i in n-1 downTo 0){dp[i][i]=1;for(j in i+1 until n){if(s[i]!=s[j])dp[i][j]=dp[i+1][j]+dp[i][j-1]-dp[i+1][j-1] else{var low=i+1;var high=j-1;while(low<=high&&s[low]!=s[i])low++;while(low<=high&&s[high]!=s[i])high--;val inner=dp[i+1][j-1];dp[i][j]=if(low>high)2*inner+2 else if(low==high)2*inner+1 else 2*inner-dp[low+1][high-1]};dp[i][j]=(dp[i][j]%mod+mod)%mod}};return dp[0][n-1].toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int countPalindromicSubsequences(string s){int n=s.size();const long long mod=1000000007;vector<vector<long long>> dp(n,vector<long long>(n));for(int i=n-1;i>=0;--i){dp[i][i]=1;for(int j=i+1;j<n;++j){if(s[i]!=s[j])dp[i][j]=dp[i+1][j]+dp[i][j-1]-dp[i+1][j-1];else{int low=i+1,high=j-1;while(low<=high&&s[low]!=s[i])++low;while(low<=high&&s[high]!=s[i])--high;long long inner=dp[i+1][j-1];if(low>high)dp[i][j]=2*inner+2;else if(low==high)dp[i][j]=2*inner+1;else dp[i][j]=2*inner-dp[low+1][high-1];}dp[i][j]=(dp[i][j]%mod+mod)%mod;}}return dp[0][n-1];} };
